ceiling_statement: The maximum inspectable causal account any H1–H8 system can give for a trusted decision is the decision's own replayable derivation: a trace, recomputable to bit-equality by third parties from committed inputs (H5/H8), in which every trusted effect appears exactly once with its cause chain back to committed inputs, produced by a construction-level invariant making effect-execution and trace-emission the same event inside the same all-or-nothing transition (H6) — so an untraced trusted act is structurally impossible, not merely forbidden. Two hard limits bound this from above: (a) no explanation can carry more causal information than the derivation itself — every sound account is a function of the replay trace, so 'explanation = verified replay' is the supremum; (b) a causal account of WHY an untrusted candidate was proposed (LLM internals, H1) is unattainable and honestly out of scope — the complete explicable object is the admission/refusal derivation, which under H1 is the entire trusted causal story; completeness of the account is exactly the completeness of effect mediation (H4 capability closure), establishable structurally but not by static analysis of arbitrary code (Rice).
derivation: (1) Information-theoretic supremum: under H5 a trusted decision is a pure finite computation from committed inputs; the full derivation (the sequence of applied rules with their inputs) determines the decision and every true causal statement about it — any sound account is derivable from the trace, and any account not derivable from it asserts causation the computation does not contain (fabrication, barred by H2). Hence no system can explain a deterministic decision beyond its own replayed derivation; the ceiling is reached when the account IS the derivation and is verified by recompute (H8), never trusted as declared. (2) Structural completeness limit: 'the trace is complete' means no trusted effect escapes mediation. By Rice's theorem this cannot be decided by inspecting arbitrary program text; the only feasible route is making it structural — effects executable solely through capabilities (H4 closure), the capability mediator emitting the trace event in the same atomic transition as the effect (H6), so trace-omission implies effect-omission by construction. This converts an undecidable global property into a local invariant of one seat — the strongest form available without whole-program formal verification of the runtime. (3) H1 boundary: statistical-model internals admit no faithful causal account with today's tools, and H1 makes this irrelevant — the candidate is data, and the admission derivation over it is the complete causal account of everything the system asserts; a system claiming to 'explain' LLM internals would exceed what is verifiable and violate H2. (4) Determinism of the account: because the trace is a pure function of committed inputs, two independent verifiers derive identical accounts — explanation itself becomes replayable, a property no post-hoc sampled or interpretive explanation system can have.
relativity_note: Relative to the declared capability-effect semantics: an 'effect' is an invocation through the capability registry / single-writer seats (source/capability-registry.lisp closure), and 'complete causal account' means every such invocation in the replay appears in the trace with its cause chain. Effects outside the declared model (raw OS syscalls bypassing the mediator) are excluded by the OS-DAC capability closure (authority-v2/capability/identities.sh), but their absence is enforced by the OS model, not proven of arbitrary code — the completeness theorem is stated and provable only against this effect semantics.
attainment_mechanism: B0 already holds the two hardest pieces. (1) The construction-level 'cannot act invisibly' invariant exists as MOP in source/deliberation.lisp: thought instances have metaclass THOUGHT-CLASS and recording happens in INITIALIZE-INSTANCE — creation and visibility are one event, guaranteed by the metaobject protocol, not by discipline; the same technique extended to effect objects (every capability invocation constructs a traced effect instance) closes the loop. (2) Trace-to-authority linkage exists in systems/orchestrator-cli/provenance-gate.lisp + source/provenance-link.lisp: tevents resolve to contract/capability/role/component (verified: %print-tevent prints the resolved contract·capability·role·component chain) with negative tests for forged/stale traces. (3) The mediation seat exists: invoke-capability in source/capability-registry.lisp plus the CLOS :around constitutional barrier in systems/orchestrator-cli/constitutional-dispatch.lisp — no command reaches its primary method unmediated. To attain ceiling today: emit trace events inside the same transition as the effect at the single-writer seats, persist the trace into the hash-chained ledger (source/memory.lisp [RATCHET-3] pattern) so accounts are offline re-verifiable (H8), and generate the traced-symbol registry FROM the architecture spec so an unregistered trusted seat fails systems/orchestrator-cli/architecture-gate.lisp at load time instead of relying on the hand-maintained register-traced! list.
b0_gap: B0 map marks AX-19 a leading axis (SINGLE_WRITER/PROOF) but with three verified residuals: (1) omega's report-stage-progress is a no-op stub — verified: the method at systems/orchestrator-omega-modules/frbr-pipeline-stage.lisp lines 402-404 returns nil — so the generation tier's runtime progress account is silently empty; (2) trace linkage is manually declared: systems/orchestrator-cli/provenance-gate.lisp seeds the registry with a hand-written dolist/loop of symbol names (register-traced!), so a new trusted seat can be added without trace registration and nothing fails closed — the B0 map's own gap line ('effect-typed lineage so an untraced trusted act cannot compile') names exactly this; (3) parts of the trace are in-memory per-session rather than persisted into a hash-chained, offline-reverifiable ledger, so the causal account is inspectable live but not yet third-party replayable end-to-end (H8 gap shared with AX-17).
lean_obligation: Theorem (account completeness and determinism relative to the capability-effect model): given an effect semantics where `effects : Execution → Finset Effect` contains exactly the mediator invocations, and a mediator satisfying the atomic-emission invariant, prove: (completeness) `∀ e ∈ effects exec, ∃! t ∈ trace exec, emits t = e ∧ causeChain t ⊆ committedInputs`; (no invisible act) `e ∉ image (emits ∘ trace) → e ∉ effects exec`; (account determinism, H5/H8) for pure derivation f and committed input x, `trace (exec₁ f x) = trace (exec₂ f x)` for any two conforming executions; (supremum) every sound account function `A : Execution → Account` (asserting only true causal statements) factors through the trace: `∃ g, A = g ∘ trace` — i.e., the verified replay trace is the maximal causal account.
